ThingDef.label: Blackfyre
ThingDef.description: The ancestral Valyrian-steel sword of House Targaryen, borne by kings before rebellion made its name a rival claim to the realm. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Brightroar
ThingDef.description: The lost ancestral Valyrian-steel sword of House Lannister, famed for its golden fittings and the doomed voyage that carried it toward Valyria. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Heartsbane
ThingDef.description: The ancestral Valyrian-steel sword of House Tarly, a severe old blade carried by generations of marcher lords. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Ice
ThingDef.description: The ancestral Valyrian-steel greatsword of House Stark, an austere symbol of justice and the old Kings of Winter. Its broad blade is a solemn reminder of the duty owed by those who pass judgment. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Lady Forlorn
ThingDef.description: The ancestral Valyrian-steel sword of House Corbray, recognizable by the heart-shaped ruby set into its pommel. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Lamentation
ThingDef.description: The lost Valyrian-steel sword of House Royce, remembered in bronze-rune chronicles and the violence of the Dance. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Longclaw
ThingDef.description: The Valyrian-steel bastard sword of House Mormont, fitted with a pale wolf pommel and suited to the long wars of the North. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Nightfall
ThingDef.description: A dark Valyrian-steel blade held by House Harlaw, carrying the hard reputation of the Iron Islands. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Oathkeeper
ThingDef.description: A crimson-rippled Valyrian-steel sword reforged from Ice and named for the promises bound to its bearer. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Orphan-Maker
ThingDef.description: The ancestral Valyrian-steel sword of House Roxton, a grimly named weapon with a plain dark blade and red grip. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Red Rain
ThingDef.description: A blood-rippled Valyrian-steel sword claimed by House Drumm, its red edge and jewel-like pommel recalling a violent history. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Truth
ThingDef.description: A slender Valyrian-steel sword associated with House Rogare of Lys, elegant in form and merciless in purpose. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Vigilance
ThingDef.description: The ancestral Valyrian-steel sword of House Hightower, a watchful symbol of Oldtown's ancient power. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.

ThingDef.label: Widow's Wail
ThingDef.description: A compact crimson-rippled Valyrian-steel sword reforged from Ice and named with cruel courtly humor. Only one can exist, and it must be recovered through a relic-hunt quest.
